name: Northern Cyprus

flag.description: A white field with a red crescent and star in the center, between a thin red horizontal stripe near the top and another near the bottom.
flag.symbolism: The flag reverses the colors of Turkey's flag; there is no official meaning, but the crescent and star are usually read as Turkish identity and the two stripes as Turkey and Northern Cyprus.

hook: Northern Cyprus turns Turkey's flag inside out: a red crescent and star on white, held between two thin red stripes.
trivia: An enormous version of the flag is laid out on the side of the Kyrenia Mountains, clearly visible from the southern half of Nicosia.
The flag was adopted in 1984, the year after the territory declared independence; before that the flag of Turkey was used.
